description: This file declares the interface IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, which defines callback methods for OCI container events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes. It includes necessary JSON handling and string headers.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface defining callback methods for various OCI container lifecycle events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container has started; provides container name and associated JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container has stopped; provides container name and associated JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container encounters a failure; provides container name and associated JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Callback invoked when an OCI container's state changes; provides container name and associated JSON data.
